svg.text: Hierarchical architecture with circuit schematics embedded in Rescale, SiLU, elastic-buffer and element-wise units
all data channels use ready/valid handshake
x token retained until both cores fire
the schematic inside each lane is replicated ×64
SiLU · one Q16.11 lane · three enabled pipeline stages
ready propagates backward; CE freezes data and valid together under backpressure
Rescale MUL: identical lane circuit to Rescale 0/1 · int32 → int16
own multiplier / shift / zero-point CSRs and registered output
mode / shape / three rescale parameter sets
